scope: four independent local release processes; paired old/new executables; userspace pipelined TCP delay; memory records; no cloud or kernel/bandwidth shaping

delay_model.description: Synthetic WAN-like topology in replica order Singapore, Frankfurt, London, Seoul. Symmetric one-way values approximately halve four measured ring RTTs; Singapore-London (85 ms) and Frankfurt-Seoul (115 ms) are estimates. This is not a measured all-pairs WAN replay.

runs.name: uniform-healthy-before

all_correct_collection.boundary: final exact output collection; not remote event latency

runs.cadence_scope: successive own-leader proposals both inside own input window, divided by round-number gap; includes recovery in silent cases

proxy.scope: proxy chunk read to forwarding; not measured network end-to-end latency
